summary: Adidas home shirt. Winamax alone on the front (unique front-of-shirt partner, extended to 2028); Hager Group and Électricité de Strasbourg also front, Soprema on the back, Würth on the sleeves, Atheo Ingenierie on the shorts. Winamax is a private French SA, Hager a German family company, ES 88.64% EDF Holding (EDF 100% French state), Soprema an independent family group, Würth family foundations, Atheo held via the private Grenoble holding OCI; no serious-abuse record sourced anywhere in the chains.
